findings.fsdQuote: The On Deck row shows up to 50 series.
findings.note: The On Deck row requests only the first 20 series.

findings.fsdQuote: Each row on the Home screen can be collapsed, and Kavita remembers the choice on the next visit.
findings.note: No collapse or remembered-state logic exists for home rows.

findings.fsdQuote: A Random button on the library screen opens a randomly chosen series from that library.
findings.note: The library detail screen has no Random button or random-series action.

findings.fsdQuote: Kavita removes a series from Want to Read automatically as soon as the user finishes reading it.
findings.note: No removal happens on finishing; a cleanup task removes fully-read series from Want to Read instead.

findings.fsdQuote: The series in a collection can be exported to a CSV file.
findings.note: There is no CSV export anywhere in the web app.

findings.fsdQuote: The owner can share a reading list through a public link that opens without signing in.
findings.note: No public or share link feature exists for reading lists.

findings.fsdQuote: A filter box for finding items appears once a list has more than 25 items.
findings.note: The filter box appears when the list has more than 10 items.

findings.fsdQuote: Brightness can be set anywhere from 0% to 100%.
findings.note: Brightness (darkness) is validated between 10 and 100.

findings.fsdQuote: A slideshow mode turns the page automatically after a set number of seconds.
findings.note: The image reader has no slideshow mode.

findings.fsdQuote: Selected text can be read aloud using the device's text-to-speech voice.
findings.note: No text-to-speech feature exists in the book reader.

findings.fsdQuote: A new password must be at least 8 characters long.
findings.note: The server requires a minimum password length of 6.

findings.fsdQuote: Changing the password requires the current password and is only open to administrators and users with the Change Password role.
findings.note: Only the new password and confirmation are required fields; the old password is not required (it is only compared with the confirmation by a validator). Read Only users are also excluded.

findings.fsdQuote: Users can turn on two-factor sign-in with an authenticator app.
findings.note: No two-factor authentication feature exists in the web app.

findings.fsdQuote: When Prompt on Download is on, Kavita asks for confirmation before any download larger than 500 MB.
findings.note: The download size warning threshold is 100 MB (104857600 bytes).

findings.fsdQuote: Changes on this page are stored only when the administrator presses Save.
findings.note: The page autosaves the form after a 300ms debounce whenever it is valid; there is no Save button.

findings.fsdQuote: A maintenance mode switch blocks all non-admin users from signing in until it is turned off.
findings.note: There is no maintenance mode setting in the general settings.

findings.fsdQuote: An invite can be given an expiry date, after which its link stops working.
findings.note: The invite form has no expiry option.
Non-pending users also get a change-password button in the actions column, and the users table shows an identity provider icon (OpenID Connect or Kavita).

findings.fsdQuote: Manage Collections is turned on by default for a new library.
findings.note: A new library defaults to manageCollections false (and manageReadingLists false).
A Browse Genres screen exists but the FSD does not describe it.
A Browse Annotations screen (all annotations with a filter) exists but the FSD does not describe it.
